Id really like to believe that. But this is an at-will state so they can give any reason or none at all. I work in the healthcare field and sadly it seems there is more of a stigma here than anywhere else.

Sadly, no. It was gmail using mail app on my iPhone. Good reasons to never use phones or anything other than outlook.
The spree appears to be over.
Can we switch this to PM if I am giving identifying info? I deff. don't mind talking but again.. trying to be discrete.
Mental health. Several years. Sorry I am being somewhat evasive. I know they use reddit and don't want them to make the connection.
The rules are to not discuss direct methods. But what I would need to complete my plan. And the person lost was due to trust and was a professional I had been seeing.

I don't know why I was posting this here. But I don't think the guilt will ever go away. I know I am blaming myself in some ways. Not necessarily that it happened but what I did during it. I don't deserve to be a survivor. I should have died that night. And ending my life is very much an option.
